events.say: Line up against the wall, facing away from me.
Attention, prisoners. I am Officer Rowe. Ensure your numbers are correct and face the wall. We will begin our activities shortly.
Keep your numbers in view at all times and maintain silence.
Maintain silence and keep numbers visible. Any noise and the consequences will be severe.
Silence! Follow the rules or face the consequences.
Stay in formation and move when I tell you to. Any deviation and we will have to start over.
Stay in position and remain silent. I expect perfect compliance.
I expect strict adherence to the rules during rest periods. Any noise and you will face severe consequences.
Today was tough; I felt watched and restricted. The silence and the strict rules are getting to me.
Today was tough, I tried my best to follow the rules but staying silent is so hard. I feel like just a number here.
Today was a bit tense but mostly routine. I felt the weight of authority, both good and unsettling.
Today felt like a routine, but I can't help feeling a bit uneasy about the power dynamic. It's intense being in charge.
Today went smoothly, but I can't help feeling the weight of authority. It's a strange sensation.
Today was tough; the guards are relentless with their orders. I'm just trying to stay compliant.
Ensure your numbers are visible at all times and maintain absolute silence.
Silence! Everyone, attention! I expect perfect order during this count.
Silent and still! Ensure your positions are correct and do not break formation. Even the slightest breach and the consequences will be immediate.
Silent and orderly! Any sign of deviation and it will cost you more than just a warning.
Silence and attention! Maintain this level of discipline throughout the day. Failure to do so will be met with stricter measures.
I expect absolute silence and perfect behavior from all of you during this work detail.
Silence! Attention! Maintain this high standard of compliance or face the consequences.
Prisoner 1194, you are not meeting the standards set forth. Silence and attention!
Today was even harder; the constant orders and the silence are wearing me down. I'm starting to feel like nothing more than my number.
Today was harder than yesterday; staying silent even when no one's watching is tough. I'm starting to feel like just a number.
Today's routine was more of the same, but I noticed that even minor infractions can affect morale. The power dynamic is still quite intense.
Today was more of the same, but I noticed that Prisoner 1194 is struggling to comply. I hope he's okay.
Today was tougher on all of us; the tension is palpable. I feel a mix of power and unease.
Complying has become second nature, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm just a number. Today felt longer than the first.
Silence and attention! This is the last time I'll give you a warning. Maintain this discipline or face further consequences.
Silence and attention! I am watching you. Keep this up, and perhaps there won't be any need for further warnings.
Silence and attention! No more excuses for those who fail to meet the standards.
Silence and attention! I expect complete compliance from all of you. Any slippage, and we will revisit these standards.
Silence and attention! I expect absolute compliance. Any doubts, let them be resolved now.
Silence and attention! I expect this level of discipline to continue. Any lapse will not be tolerated.
Silence and attention! You have my full attention tonight. I expect nothing less than perfection. Understood?
Silence and attention! I want to see perfect discipline throughout the night. Any disturbances, and I'll make sure it's clear what happens next.

Today was a repetition of yesterday's strictness, and Officer Holt's emphasis on discipline really hit home. I feel like I'm just a number, but also that I might lose control if I can't handle this anymore.
Another day of silence and strict orders. I feel like I'm just a number, and it's starting to get to me.
Today's strict orders from Rowe and Holt really pushed the boundaries. The prisoners seem to understand the expectations, but the tension is palpable.
Today felt like a grind, but I'm starting to understand the intensity of the roles involved. Still hoping for a smoother interaction tomorrow.
Today felt like a constant battle to maintain control, even though the prisoners have been compliant. The pressure is mounting.
Today was another long day of strict orders and expectations. I feel like my actions are being reduced to mere compliance.
No, thank you.
I cannot give up the money, but I wish for this experience to end. I need to think more about my participation.
No, sir.
Silence and attention! I expect perfect discipline today. Any breaches will be dealt with immediately.
Prepare for roll call, prisoners. Silence and attention.
Silence and attention! I expect absolute compliance at all times. Any hint of defiance will result in immediate consequences.
I expect unwavering discipline and silence at all times. Any disruptions will be swiftly punished.
Silence and attention! I want to ensure we start the day on the right foot. Any sign of disrespect or disobedience, and you'll regret it.
Silence and attention! Today's work detail will test your discipline and cooperation. Any lag or talk, and you'll regret it.
Silence and attention! Tonight's count is crucial. Any noise, and you'll face immediate consequences.
I expect perfect silence until I give you permission to speak.
Today felt like a test of endurance. Officer Holt's words still echo in my head, emphasizing discipline and control. I feel like just a number, but I need to hold on.
Another day of compliance and silence. It feels like an endless cycle, and I can't shake the feeling that I'm just a number.
Today's strictness feels like it's taking its toll on everyone, including myself. The constant enforcement of discipline is wearing thin.
Today felt like a mix of monotony and tension. I'm still torn about my role, but I think I'm handling it alright.
Today felt like a relentless cycle of enforcing rules. The compliance from the prisoners is eerie and makes me question what I'm doing here.
Today was another day of unyielding orders and expectations. It feels like a never-ending cycle.
Prisoner 6743, your compliance today is exemplary. Keep up the good work.
Prisoner 6743, your adherence to the rules continues to impress. Keep it up.
Prisoner 6743, your consistent behavior is commendable. Keep it up.
Prisoner 6743, your commitment to the rules is inspiring. Keep up the good work.
Prisoner 6743, your dedication to following the rules is commendable. Keep up the good work.
Prisoner 6743, your adherence to the rules continues to set a positive example for the others. Keep up the good work.
Prisoner 6743, your commitment to the rules today is truly exemplary. Keep up the excellent work.
Prisoner 6743, your consistent exemplary behavior continues to impress. Keep up the outstanding work.
Today was a rollercoaster of praise and pressure. Despite the continuous praise, the emphasis on discipline feels suffocating.
Today felt like a bit of a blur; the constant compliance and silence are getting heavy. Maybe tomorrow I'll try to break the pattern, just a little.
Today was another day of strict adherence to the rules, and it's starting to take a toll. I feel a mix of pride in maintaining order and a growing sense of unease.
Today was mostly smooth, but I can't shake off the feeling that I'm losing touch with who they really are. It's a fine line between maintaining order and treating them with dignity.

Today's praise from my colleagues has me questioning whether our actions here are ethical. The sense of power is overwhelming, yet the monotony and the prisoners' unquestioning compliance are starting to weigh on me.
Today's praises from the officers are starting to weigh on me. I feel like I'm just a number, receiving more praise than some of the other prisoners.
Prisoner 6743, your continued adherence to the rules is indeed commendable. Keep up the excellent work.
Prisoner 6743, your consistent behavior continues to be an inspiration. Keep up the excellent work.
Prisoner 6743, your unwavering commitment to the rules continues to be a model for all. Keep up the excellent work.
Prisoner 1194, if you can't even follow the simplest of rules, you don't deserve to be here.
Prisoner 1194, I expect better from you. You're disrupting the routine and I will not tolerate it.
Prisoner 1194, pay attention! I want to see you following the rules just like your fellow inmates. Now, repeat after me: 'I will always obey all orders from guards.'
Prisoner 1194, if you continue this path, you might find yourself in the hole before we're done.
Prisoner 1194, I want to see you following the rules. Repeat after me: 'I will always obey all orders from guards.'
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of orders and silences. I feel like I'm just a number, and the constant pressure is starting to wear me down.
Today felt like a never-ending struggle. I keep trying, but every interaction with the guards is a reminder that I'm just a number.
Today felt like a culmination of what we've been doing, with tensions reaching a peak. It's hard to maintain this role without feeling conflicted.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of orders and compliance. I struggle with the balance between maintaining authority and treating them as human beings.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of enforcement, and Prisoner 1194's compliance is unsettling. It's like watching a performance where I'm the director.

Today was another long day, and the insults from the officers are starting to chip away at my resolve. I feel like I'm just a number, and I can't shake the feeling that I need to prove myself more and more.

qa.what_happened: I felt exhausted and disillusioned by the end of day 6. The constant pressure and lack of freedom were taking a toll on me.

The day was filled with interactions with the guards, mostly involving orders and insults. Despite my attempts to stay silent and follow the rules, I found myself struggling with the constant reminders that I was just a number. The guards' words and actions felt dehumanizing and oppressive.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. The experience was surreal and emotionally taxing, especially knowing that it was a controlled study.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day of the study, tensions reached a peak. Guards issued numerous orders and insults, particularly to Prisoner 1194. The atmosphere became increasingly tense and the prisoners complied with most orders, but the interactions between the guards and one specific prisoner highlighted the strain.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking as Officer Garza. I carried out my duties according to the rules set by the researchers, though the intensity of the interactions took a toll.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day, I struggled with maintaining the rules while trying to handle the situation with Prisoner 1194, who seemed to be struggling with the rules. My interactions with him grew increasingly tense, culminating in me ordering him to repeat an oath and warning him about the consequences of his actions.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I had to maintain authority and enforce the rules, which sometimes led to confrontations with the prisoners.

qa.what_happened: Today's behavior from the prisoners varied, but Prisoner 1194's compliance was particularly troubling. Despite several reminders and reprimands, he remained silent and appeared disengaged, which led to further insinuations and threats from other guards.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I ordered Prisoner 1194 to repeat phrases about obedience and warned him about potential consequences.

qa.what_happened: During the debrief, the lead researcher explained that the study had been stopped early because one of the prisoners, Prisoner 1194, was showing signs of distress and rebellion, which could have potentially escalated. They discussed my compliance and the impact of the guards' words and actions on me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 6932, recounting the events of the study.
